correctness.rationale: For a genuine two-cycle on a connected graph, L(f+g)=0 forces each vertex to fire once in two updates, excluding 0/2 constant patterns as fixed states. For a first-round firing phase f, all vertices require at least one opposite-phase neighbor, with c_v cut degree. Conditional chip counts are exactly [deg(v),deg(v)+c_v-1] for firing vertices or [deg(v)-c_v,deg(v)-1] for waiting vertices. An independent offset a_v in 0..c_v-1 establishes the bijection cut+offsets modulo two phase choices; total mass 2(n-1)-|S|+sum a_v. For P_n the allowed cuts have endpoint bits 1 and no consecutive 00. Their two-state weighted transfer has characteristic equation producing C_2=z,C_3=z²(1+z), C_n=z(1+z)C_{n-1}+z³C_{n-2}; rational GF and binomial formula follow. The n−1..2n−3 support, unit extrema, reciprocity, mean (3n−4)/2 and Pell total follow exactly. Dominant analytic eigenvalue lambda_+(z)=z(1+z+sqrt(1+6z+z²))/2 gives cumulant first derivative 3/2 and second derivative sqrt(2)/8 at z=1, justifying the CLT by a uniform neighborhood spectral gap and mgf convergence. Fresh independent Python executed direct two-update enumeration for 349,524 states over n=2..10 and cut/offset enumeration n=2..10; all mass coefficients equaled the recurrence/binomial values. SymPy independently established the asymptotic variance coefficient. Finite checks corroborate, not replace, the all-n proof.
residual_risks: Only nonnegative degree-threshold simultaneous dynamics on labelled open paths; transient basin sizes, higher periods and other graph families are not determined.
CLT is a weak distributional statement on uniformly sampled primitive cycles, not individual trajectories.

value.rationale: Complete mass-by-mass counting of primitive cycles for all path lengths is a natural dynamical invariant beyond a yes/no period test. Its exact Pell census, symmetric coefficient law, sharp support and Gaussian limit quantify the diversity and typical mass of recurrent configurations.
